slot.brief: Solve an equation of the form a cos x + b sin x = c (converted to single cosine/sine) and give the general solution in terms of n.

stem: The general solution of $5\cos x-12\sin x=\dfrac{13}{2}$ is

verdicts.working: Write 5 cos x − 12 sin x = 13 cos(x + φ), where φ = arctan(12/5). Then cos(x + φ) = 1/2, so x = 2nπ − φ ± π/3.

working:
$5\cos x-12\sin x=13\cos(x+\alpha)$, where $\alpha=\tan^{-1}\left(\dfrac{12}{5}\right)$. Thus $\cos(x+\alpha)=\dfrac12$, so $x+\alpha=2n\pi\pm\dfrac{\pi}{3}$.

Independent check: Write 5 cos x − 12 sin x = 13 cos(x + φ), where φ = arctan(12/5). Then cos(x + φ) = 1/2, so x = 2nπ − φ ± π/3.
